propositions: inbound fetcher currently processes only one project even when store mapping lists multiple projects, silently dropping parent/comment/issuelink enrichment data for all but one
inbound-created tickets do not record which source project they came from, leaving bridge_project and repos fields unset
fan-out per project requires running jql pair and all three enrichment passes (parent, comment, issuelink) scoped to each configured project and merged into shared snapshot
per-project truncation ceiling must apply independently so one busy project cannot exhaust budget for others
unseeded mapping (empty projects set) must fall back to single configured project for byte-identical pre-change behavior
source project derivation uses jira-key prefix and resolve_inbound_bridge_fields stamps bridge_project and repos at CREATE write site
